svg.text: A. Fighting wing, Lead 60/2 level turn 180 deg to the left, wingman on the right (turn is away: wingman is on the outside)

Toy check (scratch script, repo core imported read-only). Lead blue, wingman orange. Controller numbers are estimates. Peak G Lead 2.02, wing 2.12; max G rate Lead 4, wing 3.2 G/s; max roll rate wing 90 deg/s.
Range, Lead to wingman (ft); green band 500 to 1,000 ft
Angle off Lead’s tail (deg); green band 30 to 60 (sweep)
Ground tracks (north up, scale 207 ft per pixel)
